# Manga Reviews Management

> An advanced self-hosted personal Manga Library, Interactive Review Editor, MangaDex Reader, and Computer Vision & Dialogue Search Platform.

## Core Documentation for AI & Developers

- [AI Context & Orientation](docs/ai-context.md): Primary entry point covering system purpose, tech stack truth, entrypoints, and the two async OCR mechanisms.
- [Architecture & Data Flow](docs/architecture.md): Visual topology diagrams, in-process vs ARQ async sequence flows, and MongoDB collection relationships.
- [Code Map & File Directory](docs/code-map.md): Task-to-files lookup table across all 16 backend routers, 20 services, and frontend pages.
- [Development & Operations](docs/development.md): Step-by-step local setup, Docker dependencies, test execution commands, and troubleshooting.
- [Coding Guidelines for Agents](AGENTS.md): Governance rules for AI agents, including TDD workflow, layer boundaries, and linting standards.
- [Translation Studio ADR](docs/translation/adr-001-translation-studio-architecture.md): Architectural decisions, envelope isolation, and storage lifecycles for manga translation.
- [Translation Operational Runbook](docs/translation/operational-runbook.md): Operations guide, runtime setup, reference-aware GC, and rollback procedures.
- [Project Readme](README.md): Human-oriented project presentation and feature overview.
